description: This file defines the 'ModuleConfigurationService' interface which provides methods to access and manage integration modules within the system, such as retrieving modules by name or code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationService
classes.description: An interface extending generic service, providing methods to retrieve integration modules based on specific criteria.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Returns a list of IntegrationModule objects matching the provided module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an IntegrationModule by its specific code.
